groups.description: Report/quote generation, verification, identity/TCB checks, and freshness — the full remote-attestation chain

categories.description: Quote/report generation and report_data field binding. Audit: what data (session pk, nonce, challenge) is bound into the report.
Verification entry points and the trust decisions made after verification. The exact trust-decision site is project-specific and must be located by reverse_trace from the verify call.
MRENCLAVE/MRSIGNER equality checks and TCB/QEIdentity/collateral/CRL validation. Audit: comparison targets correct, expiration/revocation honored.
Nonce binding, challenge-response flow, time-window checks. Audit: replay resistance.

groups.description: Enclave entry/exit and SGX platform services — trust boundary crossings

categories.description: Enclave entry — arguments are untrusted host input.
Out-of-enclave calls — return values are host-controlled and must be re-validated inside the enclave.
SGX platform services including QE, RA, and AESM interaction. Audit: error and degradation paths.

groups.description: Key generation, derivation, sealing, signature ops, AEAD, and secret hygiene — complete key lifecycle audit

categories.description: Key pair / secret key generation and the RNG source used. In a TEE the RNG must be attested (OsRng/getrandom with platform hardware entropy), never thread_rng or seeded PRNGs.
HKDF, KDF, derive_key, ECDH, X25519, key_agreement. Audit: context/info/salt binding prevents cross-context collision; peer identity is bound to an attested key.
SGX sealing, runtime sealing, and unsealing. Audit: sealing policy binds to MRENCLAVE vs MRSIGNER appropriately; unseal results are re-validated.
Signing and signature verification. Audit: signing key source is attested/sealed; verification failure paths cannot fall through; verifying key is trusted.
AEAD seal/open (ChaCha20-Poly1305, AES-GCM, etc.). Audit: nonce uniqueness, key lifetime, associated data binding.
Zeroize traits, secret wrapper types, and absence thereof. Audit: secret types lack Zeroize/ZeroizeOnDrop, or expose themselves via Debug/Display/serde.
